activity_summary: You stood by the meal-sacks and bought nothing. A man in an old soldier's coat said the talk was that the Council had spoken in Star Chamber of the present scarcity and was sending justices home. He said he had not been in the chamber. You heard three proverbs. The penny loaves on the assize-pan were shrunk. You did not measure them. Beadles stood about watching knots of idle silk-weavers and men in old soldiers' coats.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Bought nothing, and said the loaves were a penny and that he was not measuring them.

entities.name: the penny loaf

quotes.speaker: (a man in an old soldier's coat)
quotes.text: They say the Council spoke in Star Chamber of the present scarcity; (a woman at the sacks): The loaf goes by the Mayor's weight and the belly by God's.
